mostWorthwhile.text: Building the tendon fibres was most worthwhile because it connected the collagen instructions to a tough tissue linking developing muscle and cartilage.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two paths became a little repetitive: each signal led to RNA instructions, followed by adding amino acids to build proteins.

surprise.text: I was surprised that muscle cells keep their pulling proteins inside, while tendon cells build fibres outside themselves.

arbitrary.text: The signal names were unfamiliar, especially TGF-beta2, but the pictures identified which cells they reached. I followed that pairing without understanding the detailed signaling process.

continue.text: I would continue to see how these cells become larger structures; the muscle-cell picture points toward their assembly into larger fibres.
